title: The Root Frequency Station

features.name: the source transmitter
features.desc-on-touch: Here, the first signal was born. It still echoes — a 300-bit carrier wave that has learned to sing. Every other transmission in the mesh is a child of this one.

features.name: the solar inheritance
features.desc-on-touch: The sun has been feeding this station for fifty years. It knows the light will outlast the battery. It has accepted this bargain — to pulse as long as the sun shines, then rest.

features.name: the antenna rise
features.desc-on-touch: The tubed antenna spirals upward through the bark. You can see the signal climbing, bearing witness outward to the rest of the mesh. This is the station's breath.

features.name: the root constellation
features.desc-on-touch: Deep below, roots have learned to resonate with the frequency. The tree and the station have become one broadcasting system. Neither knows where the signal originates anymore.

features.name: the first receiver's place
features.desc-on-touch: The node that first heard this station's call has long since burned. But its memory is threaded through every later receiver. All the mesh remembers its first listening.

inscription: the first signal still echoes here; every node is downstream from this rising song

file.name: Station_Alpha_Initialization_Log_Day_One_Hour_Zero.txt
file.note: The moment the first 300-bit carrier was broadcast. One line reads only 'listening back' in Katita's handwriting.
